title: Captain Noah's Sanibel Florida Fishing
specs: Fish up to 50 different species annually in diverse subtropical waters
Operate 3 boats: 25' Privateer, 25' Parker, 26' Gold Line
Fish inshore, backcountry, and Gulf of Mexico waters
Rates are for up to 4 people; extra charges for 5 or 6 people
blurb: Guests fish inshore waters inside Sanibel and Captiva Islands, backcountry waters with mangrove islands, seagrasses and oyster fields, and Gulf of Mexico reefs. They target a wide variety of species including Snook, Tarpon, Redfish, Grouper, Spotted Seatrout, Sharks, Snapper, Cobia, Permit, King Mackerel, and more. The charters are kid friendly and provide all fishing licenses, tackle, bait, ice, water, and cooler.
extraNote: Add $50 for 5 people, $100 for 6 people · Add $200 for Reef/Gulf of Mexico trips · Payment accepted cash or credit · Port Sanibel Marina, meet at the "Ship Store" near restrooms, kayaks and boat ramp.
